annotation.title_clean: 無人航空機の登録講習機関及び登録更新講習機関に関する省令
annotation.title_en: Ordinance on Registered Training Institutions and Registered Renewal Training Institutions for Unmanned Aircraft
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国土交通省 (Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Japanese MLIT ministerial ordinance (2022, amended 2024) under the Civil Aeronautics Act setting procedures and standards for registering institutions that train and certify unmanned aircraft (drone) pilots and renewal training: applications, manager qualifications, curriculum standards, annual external audits, record-keeping.
key_provisions_or_claims: Registration applications to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism with documents on facilities and instructors
Training managers must be 25+ with no recent violations; curricula must meet notified hours and standards
Completion certificates only after passing completion examination
Annual external audit with results reported to the Minister within one month
Records retained three years; Minister may take over renewal training duties
